servinfo.title: Crankshaft Front Oil Seal Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: Hoist vehicle and remove right side engine under side cover.
Remove crankshaft pulley referring to Step 3) – 5) in “Removal” under Oil Pump Assembly Removal and Installation:K14D .
Using a flat-bladed screwdriver or the like wrapped with protective tape, remove oil seal (1) slowly.

item.ptxt: If tip of screwdriver scratches oil pump assembly, it may cause oil leakage.
Carefully remove oil seal not to damage oil pump assembly.
If crankshaft edge is dented, it may disturb smooth installation of crankshaft pulley.
Carefully remove oil seal not to damage crankshaft edge.

s1.ptxt: Using special tool and hammer, install new oil seal (1) into timing chain cover.
Install crankshaft pulley referring to Step 19) – 21) in “Installation” under Oil Pump Assembly Removal and Installation:K14D .
Install right side engine under side cover.
